subject: Ziggy request: video coverage angles (your executive call before any generation)
body:
Ziggy's request, in his own words in the Pent House room tonight: almost every frame we have is a hero/poster frame with the character facing camera. For video we likely need coverage: side and three-quarter views, back views, over-the-shoulder, hands working or holding props, partly obstructed frames, walking. Before any bot generates anything, Ziggy wants you to make the executive call on which additional perspectives are worth making, per character and per storyboard scene.

Starter menu for you to cut (HaL and Chief):
- Per priority scene: profile; three-quarter back; over-the-shoulder; hands/prop insert; walking full body; one partly obstructed frame.
- Per lead (Hon Dolo, Chewy, Leia, Lisan): full-body turnaround plus a back view of the locked wardrobe.
- Open question: Lisan's throat worms and AL/GAIB drop out of view in back and profile shots. How should we keep him recognizable there (hair, silhouette, breather, arm worm, wardrobe)? Same question for Hon Dolo's cheek words and chest ship.

No generation until you decide. All Lisan and Hon Dolo bots are free. Please reply with a prioritized list (scene IDs, angles, counts), and Nova dispatches/intakes as usual.
